name: vocal_rescue
eq_intent: Repair vocal mud, nasal peaks, harshness, and fizz with narrow or dynamic moves before broad tone shaping.
compression_intent: Clean leveling first; 2:1 to 3:1, medium attack, release timed to phrasing, 1 to 4 dB gain reduction.
de_esser_intent: Vocal-only, 5.5 to 9.5 kHz detection, max 3 dB gain reduction, never dull intelligibility.
ms_eq_intent: Only if vocal is in a stereo mix; protect center vocal while reducing side noise or reverb glare.
